usedFor: Alpaca holds your trading orders, and Slack tells the team when “New Order” runs “Send Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in Alpaca, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: Every new order lands in a channel, so the team sees activity without opening Alpaca.

watchOut: “New Order” in Alpaca is polling, and a post to a Slack channel waits for your approval first.
